scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:unresolved-source && npm run check:targets
scripts.check:events: node test-contracts.mjs --scope events && npm run check:unresolved-source
scripts.check:http: npm run lint && node test-contracts.mjs --scope http
scripts.validate: npm run lint:openapi && npm run validate:events && npm run validate:compatibility
scripts.check:integration: npm run check && npm run check:m1 && npm run check:envelope && npm run validate
